# 01 — Adult ICU cohort extraction (SHORT)

[Full notebook](../notebooks/01_icu_cohort.ipynb)

## Objective

Build the adult ICU cohort, anchored to the first ICU stay within each hospital admission. A patient can contribute multiple admissions.

## Input

- MIMIC-IV v3.1 `icustays`, `patients`, and `admissions` in BigQuery.

## Output and downstream use

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_icu`
- Input to COPD diagnosis selection in phase 02.

## Key methods and scope

- Executes `sql/01_extract_base.sql`, which creates or replaces the cohort table.
- Uses estimated hospital-admission age `anchor_age + admission_year - anchor_year >= 18`; preserves raw `anchor_age` and `age_anchor_topcoded`.
- Keeps the first ICU stay per patient and hospital admission, not the first admission in a patient's life.
- Age is approximate; anchor age 91 represents the aggregated oldest group. ICU LOS uses continuous elapsed days.
- The notebook loads rows for schema checking and prints `info()` and shape; it does not display row previews or prove all downstream content QA.
